name: Desk Notes Pro
description:
Desk Notes Pro turns XENEON Edge into a persistent multi-board workspace for reminders, checklists, and active projects. Keep Today, Work, Personal, and Current Project boards one touch away, with sixteen native iCUE Entry fields per board and no account, cloud service, or helper app.

Use plain entries for notes and [ ] entries for touch checklists. Pro adds multiple note cards, optional card headings, categories, pinned items, completed-item history, touch board tabs, and optional automatic board rotation. Choose cards, columns, or list arrangements and nine polished note themes, then fine-tune font sizing, text, accent, background, and transparency in iCUE.

Compact XENEON slots intentionally show the highest-priority portion of large boards with a clear remaining-item count, while larger slots expand to the full board. Completion state, active board state, and history are stored locally per widget instance.

No external paywall, account, API key, unsupported keyboard capture, or recurring service dependency is required.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for XENEON Edge.
release_notes:
• Four persistent boards with sixteen native iCUE Entry fields each
• Touch board tabs, note cards, categories, pinning, and completed-item history
• Optional automatic board rotation with cards, columns, and list arrangements
• Nine note themes with local board and completion persistence
• Support for all eight XENEON Edge layouts
